title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The average energy per particle is correctly stated as E = kT/2.

title: Boltzmann Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies and uses the Boltzmann distribution function in the calculation.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The integration for calculating the average energy is properly set up with the correct limits and integrand.

title: Equipartition Principle
description: Essential Criteria: The principle of equipartition of energy is accurately stated and related to the average energy calculation.

title: Degree of Freedom
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the number of degrees of freedom in the system.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to correctly apply the limits of integration or makes a sign mistake in the calculation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student discusses any alternative methods to arrive at the same conclusion.
